gbm_population_evidence.quote: LY3214996 Plus Abemaciclib in Recurrent Glioblastoma Patients

candidate_evidence.quote: 400 mg of LY3214996 QD for 6 doses and 100 mg of Abemaciclib BID for 11 doses over 5.5 days prior to surgical resection.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: participants who have progressed on or following standard (Stupp regimen) therapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic analysis of tumor tissue: Total and Unbound LY3214996 and Abemaciclib (and related M2 and M20 metabolites) concentration in enhancing and non-enhancing tumor tissue

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Phase 0: PD Analysis: Phase 0: percentage of pRSK+, pERK+, pRB+, pFOXM1, MIB-1+ and Cleaved Caspase 3+ cells from the surgical tissue will be quantified and compared to baseline archival tissue.

coder_notes: Phase registered EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/2): translational subset. Eligibility requires WHO Grade IV glioma recurrent after Stupp; conditions name glioblastoma. No IDH requirement stated, so historical terminology. Biomarker eligibility is a combined archival-tissue requirement (RB, CDKN2A/B/C loss or CDK4/6 amplification, pERK) linked to the CDK4/6 and ERK inhibitors.
